reason: We already pay for Codex and Claude cloud agents, and their built-in scheduling covers what we need. Adding a pre-alpha tool from one developer to our morning PR routine is not worth the switching cost.
objection: Our clients may not allow AI agents on their code, and a one-person pre-alpha project is another thing I would have to vouch for in a security review.
would_change_my_mind: A clear case where the vendor scheduling fails us, like budget overruns or runs looping overnight, plus a few named teams running it in production for months.
